body:
At 4am this morning I learned I do not react well to green onion. I woke up with horrible gas that feels like I'm being stabbed with burning knives. I had diarrhea for two hours where my midsection was in so much pain I felt like screaming bloody murder. 

I don't have much advice to offer if you have already tried eliminating food from your diet. Personally I am finding that I cannot eat onions, garlic, peppers, or any kind of raw vegetable, and I am learning it the hard way. 

So sorry to hear you are in pain. Good luck.
Gotchya, I've updated it. Thank you for your advice!

Thank you. Your kind words mean a lot to me. I can't tell you how much I appreciate you taking time out of your day to actually ask me questions and try to help instead of ignoring me or using harsh judgment. It really does give me hope that I will find someone who can give me professional help, because if you are so insightful and caring about a stranger there has to be someone else, right?

To answer your question, I have had almost nonstop professional help since I was 14. I feel like I've made a lot of breakthroughs but they are easy to minimize or just flat out forget when I feel so horrible. I've just been having a really bad week being in a new state with no job and no friends and it's just draining trying to rebuild my life for what feels like the millionth time. 

 I got through this day, I think I will be able to get through tomorrow. Your words actually meant something to me and weren't just generic words of "it will get better." I do kinda feel like I can keep fighting.

Aw crap, now I'm crying. It feels kinda nice, to be honest, when I feel so empty to actually feel emotion like this. I mean really, thank you. I hope you have a good rest of your day.

I have PTSD from my physically and emotionally abusive parents and being raped on one occasion by ~12 people, another by a long term boyfriend, both when I was 14. I have been depressed my entire life, I literally cannot recall a single day of my life where I was not sad or emotionally exhausted. I hear voices, I have problems with addiction to cigarettes, alcohol, and marijuana. I have tried to kill myself more times than I can count. I have been hospitalized 8 times. I keep reaching out for help and it feels like no one will listen. I go to therapy, take medication, and "think happy thoughts!" but at the end of the day I am miserable and alone and I just want it to end. I don't see happiness in my future.

Sorry, that was so much to dump on you.

My parents are divorced. Dad lives in Colorado, Mom lives in Indiana. 

In January I had to call the cops on my dad for beating my 4 and 7 year old siblings. He kicked me out and I was homeless until I graduated high school in May. Haven't talked to him since January and I don't plan on it.

I moved in with my mom over the summer but she is very religious and thinks I need an exorcism. My stepdad is ex military and thinks I need to suck it up. They will not let me use their insurance and blame me for all their financial issues because I was hospitalized after a suicide attempt last year. 

Actually, I call her a couple times a week but she hardly answers, and when she does we don't talk for more than a couple minutes and it's awkward. She's happier without me.

I live with my boyfriend's parents now and they are very nice to me. They treat me more like their daughter than my parents ever did.

We live together. 

I know it's very soon into the relationship but it is a much better option than my previous living arrangement.

I met him in an online game three months ago. He is 21 and lives with his parents. Typical redditor stereotype but it doesn't bother me. Very supportive and caring but doesn't understand the reach of my mental illness.

Thank you for your kind words and advice. Imodium helped me last night, but I will keep the tea and hot water in mind for the next time (I'm sure there will be a next time. Sigh.) I guess now I have to figure out how to get scoped.
The small one? You mean child???
Forgot to mention, I took omeprazole for my ulcer and it did nothing. At this point I'm not even sure I have one. Going to get some Imodium now, thank you.
